notes: VBX LABS → APOLLO (affirmative claims / counterclaims, separate from X Brands' equity claims below). Sources: Kevin's Statement of Claims (Mar 2026), the Evidence Brief (Mar 1, 2026) and the Master Reference (Mar 2026) in Drive. (1) ACCOUNT RECEIVABLE: Steve Baghoomian told Jayan Hong on Oct 10, 2024 that the Supherb account is negative at least $50,000 excluding interest, and that VBX's first claim would be for an accounting. (2) BREACH OF THE PRODUCTION DEAL: the White Label Agreement (Sep 2019), the License & Service Agreement (Nov 19, 2019) and the Consulting Services Agreement (Jan 2021) gave VBX the exclusive right / right of first refusal to manufacture and distribute Supherb products. Apollo moved production to outside manufacturers while under contract: the Feb 25, 2023 cease-and-desist to CannaVision Laboratories documents it, and Supherb was soliciting other Type 7 facilities for extraction in June 2024. (3) PERFORMANCE RECORD rebutting Apollo's claim: 3+ years of deliveries, METRC transfer records, VBX's Jan 18, 2023 internal Supherb summary (first dusted diamond blunts, Big Grape top seller), 2022 Emerald Cup Best Solventless for VBX-made rosin carts. (4) OFFSET: Apollo's Nov 6, 2024 'accounting' claims $1,014,355.42 owed by VBX and is one-sided; it must be netted against the receivable, the IP license value and unpaid consulting compensation. (5) BAD FAITH: Oct 7, 2024 Baghoomian memo quoting Apollo's side that 'everyone could walk away' if the financials were reconciled; Apollo filed suit instead. Open points for counsel (Gennady Lebedev): confirm whether the production-side claims are subject to the Sept 11, 2024 arbitration notice, and quantify the receivable from VBX invoices and METRC data.
